intent: Text and figures that spin into their new value on staggered slot reels: only characters that change roll through glyphs of their own class, and each lands with one small clunk.

stack.animation: motion/react: translateY in percent on each glyph strip, width and blur keyframes, AnimatePresence for non-spinning swaps

layout.root: any text element (as); reels inherit font, size, tracking and line height
layout.reel: inline-block per character, baseline from a zero-width space in flow; the strip sits in an absolute overflow-hidden window. At rest the window extends 0.16em above and below the line box. While spinning the window is exactly the line box and each row clips its own glyph, so the slot shows one character and a passing glyph is a clean horizontal cut
layout.rows: each row exactly 1lh tall; strip moved by translateY(-k/n × 100%)
layout.width: an invisible copy of the landing character is measured (ResizeObserver too) and the reel width eases to it over the spin; until measured the character renders in flow
layout.pairing: old and new values paired per character; padded right for words and left for figures (align auto); keys count from the anchored side
layout.wrapping: <wbr> after each space so long values wrap between words
layout.demo: black stage, max-width 960px: eyebrow, name on reels, build line on smaller reels, hairline, Passed on list and a Spin again pill

typography.name: display, clamp(2.5rem, 0.5rem + 8cqi, 6.5rem), 500, leading 0.98, tracking -0.05em; the longest name holds one line from 390px up
typography.buildLine: mono 13–14px uppercase, tracking 0.12em, white/55; values white, tabular-nums
typography.passedOn: mono 12px, struck through with a white/25 line, opacity 1 → 0.5 by age

motion.strip: [old, 4 + 4×spins filler (+0–2 by position), new, one past]; filler from the character's class via a stable hash
motion.spin: y over duration (default 900ms), ease-out cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), keys at 0 / 0.86 / 1: start, a peek 0.12 row past the stop, then the stop. The peek is a fraction of one row, not of the travel
motion.stagger: stagger ms (default 45) between reels, counted only across reels that change
motion.cleanup: after the last reel lands the strips and padding cells are removed; onSettle fires
motion.reducedMotion: no strips and no peek; changed characters cross-fade in 150ms

responsive: Reels inherit the host's type, so they scale with clamp() or cqi sizes; the width re-measures on resize. Long values wrap between words at <wbr>; the demo name is sized to hold one line from 390px up.
accessibility: Visual reels are aria-hidden; a visually hidden copy of the full value is always present.
announce adds a polite live region that speaks the value once it has landed, never the filler glyphs.
Demo button is a real 44px button with a 2px focus-visible ring offset on the stage and a 0.97 press scale.
avoid: a split-flap board, slot-machine frame, lever or coloured lights
spinning characters that did not change
letters spinning through digits or symbols
an overshoot measured against the whole travel, or blur that smears one glyph into the next
announcing filler glyphs to screen readers
